Uber Technologies, Inc. is a global technology company providing ride-sharing, delivery, and logistics services. In 2024, the company recorded strong financial performance driven by increased demand for mobility and delivery services.

Financial Metric 2024 Value (USD) Total Revenue (Annual Sales) $43.9 Billion Net Income $9.8 Billion Gross Bookings $162.8 Billion Operating Income $2.8 Billion Adjusted EBITDA $6.48 Billion

Business Segment Revenue Percentage Mobility (Ride-sharing) $25.1 Billion 57% Delivery (Uber Eats) $13.8 Billion 31% Freight (Logistics) $5.1 Billion 12%

Revenue by Geographic Region (2024)

Region Revenue Share United States & Canada $23.6 Billion 53.7% Europe, Middle East & Africa $12.5 Billion 28.5% Asia-Pacific $5.0 Billion 11.5% Latin America $2.8 Billion 6.4%

In conclusion, Uber demonstrated strong growth and profitability in 2024. The company's diversified business model and global presence supported sustained revenue expansion.
